title: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard
summary: Nvidia announced Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, their latest large language model optimized for conversational AI and task completion, along with NeMo Switchyard, a customization framework that allows developers to fine-tune and deploy LLMs efficiently on RTX GPUs and DGX systems.
problem_solved: Enables enterprises and developers to deploy customized, high-performance LLM applications on Nvidia hardware with optimized inference and fine-tuning capabilities.
why_valuable: Provides a complete, hardware-software integrated AI solution that bridges the gap between consumer-grade RTX GPUs and enterprise DGX systems for LLM deployment and customization.
